**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 (Audit Rights) already satisfies the preferred playbook position on every parameter:

| Parameter | Preferred | Document (§ 22) |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | Once / 12 months | Once in any twelve-month period ✓ |
| Notice | 30 days' written | At least thirty days' prior written ✓ |
| Timing | Business hours | Normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption ✓ |
| Auditor | Independent, confidentiality-bound | Same, and off-site where practicable ✓ |
| Cost | Vendor's, unless underpayment > 5% | Vendor bears unless underpayment exceeds five percent ✓ |
| System access | None | Express bar on direct system access, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, third-party confidential info ✓ |

Section 22.3 adds further customer-side protection (findings are our Confidential Information, enforcement-only use, copy of the final report, and shortfall payment resolves the audited quantity absent fraud or demonstrable error). Section 23 contains only a heading, and a document-wide search for audit/inspection/verification/monitoring/remote-access language surfaced no competing right binding us. Nothing to negotiate here.
